request: The target should begin at 9 rather than 3, because that is what my team has to hit each week, and I want it set first.
I want the goal to start at 80 rather than 100, because that is a fair target for my patients each week, and it keeps the first screen realistic.
Could the theme go yellow instead of mint? It is easier to see in the classroom and the bright colour keeps the children engaged.
The theme should be grey instead of ink, because the dark ink made the screen look heavy during long fittings, and grey keeps the clients calm.
I think Little Helper suits the app better, since I use it to check on the roses and the tasks I give the gardener, and Rose Care was too narrow.
The mark should start at 20 rather than 10, because that is what my students need to pass the week, and I want it shown first.
My Corner is a better name than Savings Pots, because I keep my own little plans there and not only the money, so the new name is more honest.
Could the app be renamed Check In? I use it to note who arrives at the clinic each morning, and Darts has nothing to do with that.
I would like the app to switch to dark mode, because I bake late at night and the bright screen makes it hard to judge the colours of the dough.
The app should go to dark mode, since I check the shop figures after closing and a white screen is harsh when the lights are off.
